data.name: Boston Scavenger Hunt
data.headline: Race around Boston and solve challenging clues while learning about the city
data.description:
#Scavenger Hunt

Think you can find the many “hidden gems” around Boston?  There are so many surprises hidden in unexpected places. Race around the city and solve challenging clues on an exciting Photo Scavenger Hunt that’s a fun experience for all ages. Take pictures, solve puzzles and discover fascinating facts about Boston along the way.

meeting_point.address: Front steps of the MA State House

data.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellation Policy#

Full refund or credit with at least 24 hours notice by customer.

Full refund or credit if a tour is canceled by PhotoWalks due to weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances. 

No refunds for no-shows.
data.booking_notes: Scavenger Hunt Clues will be sent after purchase.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
The health and safety of all PhotoWalks participants are of utmost importance. Please review the new protocol measures to keep all guests safe during the tour experience.

* **Face Masks** -  All staff and participants are REQUIRED TO WEAR a mask for personal protection and the safety of others. Masks will NOT be provided to guests.

* **Social Distancing** - Guests must maintain a 6-foot distance from other participants during all points of the tour.

* **Tour Size** - Tour groups are limited to less than 10 participants for a more personalized experience to enable Social Distancing.

* **Restrooms** - There are NO RESTROOM stops.
